bullets.text: Most merged work progresses from review-ready to merged in a median 5.0 days, although 1 in 10 merged PRs took about 52 days or longer; this reflects the time in review and merge stages for merged PRs.
A large review queue has 295 open PRs with no human response yet, with a median wait of 37 days, indicating many PRs are stuck at the initial triage or response stage.
There are 303 open PRs waiting for a reviewer’s lgtm across the repo, with a median wait of 62 days, showing a prolonged reviewer queue for those changes.
The sig/api-machinery team is a major contributor to the reviewer queue with 104 PRs waiting for a reviewer’s lgtm and a median wait of 66 days, reflecting team-level backlog in that review stage.

More PRs are waiting on their author than waiting for a reviewer’s lgtm: 383 open PRs are waiting on authors with a median wait of 23 days, compared with 303 waiting for reviewer lgtm; this highlights author-side queues versus reviewer-side queues.
